text:
maya - marketing lead: Quick sync: planning the Saffron customer story. Need interview scheduled, legal signoff, and gated brief publish checklist by next Wed.
sam - producer: Scheduled a 20m interview with Diego on Mon 10:00am PT. Will record and transcribe.
maya - marketing lead: Diego, ahead of the call could you drop 3 short bullets with the biggest outcomes (metrics or customer language) so we can prep interviewer?
diego (customer): Sure. Topline: ~3x throughput, ~42% reduction in per-token cost, and big improvement in 99th pct latency. I can share exact slides after the call.
jin - product marketer: Helpful. We’ll want before/after baselines to make a small chart for the blog post.
sam - producer: Interview run of show: 20m on product outcomes, 10m to draft quote variants together. I’ll provide audio + transcript, and two quote drafts for legal.
lex - legal: Please attach a short release form to the draft. If the 42% number is used we need explicit written approval from Diego included in the release. Otherwise we should use "approximately 40%".
sam - producer: Timeline: raw audio + transcript by Tue EOD; quote drafts by Wed morning.
maya - marketing lead: Plan is launch post + two social snippets + webinar CTA. Tara, any constraints for the hero image or asset timeline?
tara - design: I’ll reserve the hero slot and mock banner. Need final approved quote and Saffron logo usage guidance by Thu to finalize layouts.
owen - sales: For gated brief downloads, please route leads to AE queue and include webinar invite in nurture. Ops needs the SFDC campaign name to wire it.
maya - marketing lead: I’ll create the campaign. @comms-bot add a follow-up to assign leads to Owen’s queue once the form is live.
comms-bot: Action created: "Saffron brief - route leads to owen.sales"  due 2026-04-07
sam - producer: Draft quote for legal eyes: "Redwood Inference reduced Saffron's per-token cost by 42% while improving 99th percentile latency, enabling near real-time responses for their customer-facing product." Thoughts?
lex - legal: I'll review. Quick note: avoid implying contractual promises. Also require signoff on exact numbers in the release. If Saffron confirms, we can publish the 42% stat.
diego (customer): I confirm the 42% and latency improvement and will attach an internal verification slide after the interview. Happy to sign the release.
jin - product marketer: Once legal clears phrasing I’ll prepare two headline options: 1) benchmark-forward, 2) customer-outcome-forward.
maya - marketing lead: Also want Diego to be a guest on a webinar tied to the launch. Can we pick a tentative date?
sam - producer: Suggest Wed two weeks from now, 9:30am PT. Diego, does that work?
diego (customer): Weekdays mornings PT work. Two weeks out is fine.
maya - marketing lead: Great — tentatively locked. Owen, we’ll include webinar CTA in the gated brief nurture.
owen - sales: Please include a 2-slide quick talking points doc for SDRs so they can qualify inbound.
sam - producer: I’ll draft a 2-slide SDR playbook from the interview.
tara - design: Placeholder banner in calendar. Final assets due Thu morning.
lex - legal: I’ll prioritize quick turnaround on quote clearance; aim to return redlines within 24 hours of receiving drafts.
sam - producer: After legal signoff I’ll finalize two quote variants and a 500-word case brief draft. Please review within 48h.
maya - marketing lead: Action summary: 1) Sam: run interview Mon 10am PT. 2) Diego: provide baseline numbers and verification slides post-interview. 3) Sam: transcript + quote drafts by Tue/Wed. 4) Lex: legal signoff within 24h of drafts. 5) Tara: deliver design assets by Thu. 6) Maya: create SFDC campaign + webinar RSVP + lead routing. 7) Owen: AE followup & SDR playbook.
jin - product marketer: Micro-ask: include a one-page summary (2 slides) with top metrics and quotes for enablement. Sam, can you draft it?
sam - producer: Yup, will include it in my deliverables.
comms-bot: Reminder set: "Check legal signoff"  2026-04-08
maya - marketing lead: Thanks all — I’ll post the official launch calendar entry once legal clears quotes. :rocket:
